description: List chat app bridges (GET /v1/bridges): one hub's with hubId, otherwise every bridge the token may see (its own, and those of workspaces where it is a member above basic); ownerId narrows that to one owner. Each bridge has its network and connector, state (setup or active), the chats it answers in (allowed), require_mention, session_scope, paused, hold (why the platform paused it: plan_limit or account_suspended; null for the owner's own pause), the bot, its invite links, secrets_set (which secrets are stored, by name), its etag, and status: reason (Setup, Starting, Connected, Paused, Unavailable, TokenMissing, TokenRejected), phase, ready, applied (whether the latest change has reached the bridge) and summary, the status in plain words. The platform's own diagnostic message is never included. Requires the hubs:read scope. Reads only.

apiUrl.description: Control-plane base URL. Configured credentials may only be used on their configured origin; defaults to https://api.thalovant.com.

hubId.description: Hub UUID: list only this hub's bridges.

limit.description: At most this many bridges, 1-500. The API answers up to 200 when omitted.

loginScope.description: Optional login scope used with THALOVANT_EMAIL and THALOVANT_PASSWORD.

ownerId.description: Owner UUID: narrow the visible bridges to this owner's.

name: thalovant_list_bridges
title: List Chat App Bridges
